newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Commercial Bank up on profit news.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial Bank up on profit news.

text.p: Siam Commercial Bank's shares rose on Wednesday after news that the bank expected a 17.08 percent increase in unaudited third quarter profits to 2.333 billion baht, brokers said.
The share price hit a high of 216 baht before settling at 214 baht or up four at 0405 GMT.
The bank bucked the trend in a market where selling of bank shares by disillusioned foreign investors underweighting Thai stocks has been the vogue since late last week.
Arparporn Sawengpak, a bank analyst at Nava Finance and Securities Plc, said: "I think this can help sentiment within the banking sector."
She estimated SCB had increased its spread by 11 basis points during the third quarter to 3.57 percentage points.
She said the bank was under less pressure than some in its sector to increase deposits since its bad loan to deposit ratio was within Bank of Thailand guidelines.
Barry Yates, head of research at the Multi Credit Corporation of Thailand, said the market was a little surprised by the timing of the bank's statement.
"It really depends on what the others come up with now. After 14 percent growth (for the bank) in the second quarter most people were expecting a third quarter increase."
